question: Who is one of the authors of the book 'Overthrowing Cricket's Empire: How Every Team Beat England for the First Time' released in July 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abishek Mukherjee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Abishek Mukherjee** is a well-known cricket writer and historian.
 
• He has written extensively on the history of cricket, particularly focusing on lesser-known stories and events.
 
• Mukherjee has contributed to various prominent cricket publications and websites.
 
• He co-authored the book 'Overthrowing Cricket's Empire: How Every Team Beat England for the First Time' which was released in July 2024.
 
• The book discusses the historical milestones of different cricket teams defeating England for the first time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cricket Literature**

 
 
• Cricket literature encompasses a wide range of works including biographies, histories, and statistical analyses.
 
• Prominent cricket writers include Gideon Haigh, Neville Cardus, and C.L.R. James.
 
• Books on cricket history often explore the social and cultural impact of the sport.
 
• The genre has a dedicated following among cricket enthusiasts who seek in-depth knowledge and historical context.
 
 
 
• **Historical Matches**
 
 
• Historical cricket matches are often remembered for their significance in the sport's development.
 
• First victories against established teams mark important milestones for emerging cricketing nations.
 
• Such matches are celebrated for showcasing the rise of new talent and strategic advancements.
 
• These events contribute to the rich tapestry of cricket history and its global evolution.
 
 
 
• **Cricket Historians**
 
 
• Cricket historians play a crucial role in documenting and analyzing the sport's past.
 
• They often uncover lesser-known stories and provide context to major events and figures.
 
• Their work helps preserve the heritage of cricket for future generations.
 
• Notable cricket historians include David Frith and Mihir Bose.
